Find Subly+ under Installed apps and turn it on
Why the Accessibility permission is needed

Subly+ uses Android's Accessibility service to keep your subtitles in sync with the video.

The service ONLY reads the player's on-screen position bar (the current time) so your loaded .srt subtitle appears at the right moment. It does not read screen content and does not collect, store, or share any personal or sensitive data — everything stays on your device.

You can turn this permission off at any time from Settings. Tap “Agree and enable” to continue.
